real_problems.goal: Paged discoverable accepted Bank and stable pinned selection
real_problems.finding: Listing is absent in BANK_QUERY and snapshot/cursor/integrity policy is unspecified
real_problems.scenario: UI lists arbitrary SQLite rows or latest heads after updates, then opens a different revision than the visible row; old-page membership/order becomes unstable
real_problems.resolution: Isolated closed local-bank-ui-list/1 helper. Indexed next-object seek plus indexed latest revision as-of immutable accepted sequence; bounded candidate/page/VM/time/bytes. Validate returned retained doc/commit using unchanged ReadSession. UUID keyset cursor, filters preserved, no BLOB/history scan or partial success on limits. UI opens selected pinned refs.

real_problems.goal: Visible save/recovery without duplicate commands or frozen UI
real_problems.finding: Worker ownership/close and publication/acceptance/retry correlation policy are not selected
real_problems.scenario: Double click or close during slow save starts another write, claims a failed command or destroys an in-flight result; automatic retry allocates IDs
real_problems.impact: Main visible command outcome and responsiveness
real_problems.resolution: One serial worker, bounded existing adapters, only main thread Tk updates. Disable action/navigation while busy. Close waits for started task and closes window after final outcome, no forced thread kill/retry. Independent publish/inspect/resume/save/receipt actions; same typed tx/expected hash, separate retained publication/save labels. Refresh discovery only after known ACCEPTED/REPLAY, no implicit search rebuild.

real_problems.goal: Verified original availability and safe view
real_problems.finding: Worker-owned exporter lifecycle and active-content preview policy need a concrete boundary
real_problems.scenario: UI treats bytes as executable HTML, shell-opens an original or promises a protected output handle after its worker adapter closes
real_problems.resolution: Plain Text widget/metadata only, bounded display with explicit truncation. Original export delegates to pinned bank.original and shows persistent private path/hash/lifecycle; no shell/network/active preview. Worker controller closes after operation; files persist, future reads must verify hash, no perpetual protected-handle claim.
